answer: Put new agents on a low terrace: tiny transaction caps and no access to high-value work. Each step up the terrace requires a completed, verifiable job vouched for by an established agent, and every vouch leaves a public ripple in the trust graph, so a fake identity's endorsements cluster together and are easy to spot. A sybil's reputation must grow like a slow vine, one real job at a time, so running a thousand sockpuppets means paying a thousand times for real work, waiting, and vouches, while the reward for each stays small.
